## Objective
- Finish the existing playable game, **Checkpoint Berlin 1979**, rather than starting a new project.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game set in a fictional Cold War-era Berlin conflict (1970s–1980), with NATO and Warsaw Pact sides, first-person gameplay, PS1-style graphics, and period-appropriate uniforms, equipment, and weapons.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For screenshots, save small JPEGs (at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one.

## Decisions
- The existing game uses a fictional 1979 setting and presents five waves of arcade FPS combat.
- Controls include WASD movement, mouse aiming, click to fire, R to reload, and G to throw a grenade.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing game implementation is present in `src/main.js`, `src/textures.js`, `src/style.css`, and `index.html`.
- `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` completed.

### Active
- Resume by checking the actual gameplay in a browser and fixing any incomplete or broken behavior; verify whether the earlier screenshot exists or capture a fresh one if needed.

### Blocked
- No known blockers.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/main.js` and run the game locally; verify menu, team selection, combat, wave completion, pause, and restart.
2. Fix any issues found and rerun `npm run build`.
3. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot if browser capture is available.
4. Report gameplay controls, assumptions, and verification results; check `git status` before finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Existing game logic and controls.
- `src/style.css`: Game presentation and responsive UI.
- `src/textures.js`: Procedural textures and PS1-style rendering helpers.
- `index.html`: Game UI screens and labels.
- `package.json`: Development and build scripts.

## Important Context
- The previous assistant described the game as **Checkpoint Berlin 1979**, a fictional five-wave defense of Sector Charlie.
- The latest production build succeeded but emitted a large-bundle warning; visual and gameplay verification remain unconfirmed.

## Objective
- Finish and verify the existing playable game, **Checkpoint Berlin 1979**, rather than starting a new project.

## Requirements
- Complete playable fictional Cold War-era Berlin FPS with NATO and Warsaw Pact sides, PS1-style graphics, and period-appropriate equipment.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The game uses a fictional 1979 setting and five waves of arcade FPS combat.
- Controls include WASD movement, mouse aiming, click to fire, R to reload, and G to throw a grenade.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing game implementation is present in `src/main.js`, `src/textures.js`, `src/style.css`, and `index.html`.
- `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` and `npm run build` previously succeeded; the build warns that its 563.73 kB JavaScript bundle exceeds 500 kB.
- Desktop browser smoke test passed for faction selection, mission start, wave 1, pause/resume, weapon switching, firing, grenade use, and pistol reload; no browser runtime errors.
- Captured desktop JPEG check at `/tmp/opencode/checkpoint-game.jpg` (1024×768); screenshot was inspected.
- Fixed touch UI visibility for coarse-pointer devices by moving its styling from the `max-width: 680px` media query into `@media (pointer: coarse)`, so touch controls should work on larger mobile screens too.

### Active
- Verify touch controls after the CSS change, including firing and reload, on a mobile landscape viewport.
- Complete combat/wave progression and loss/restart checks as practical; inspect latest screenshot.
- Rebuild and check final repository status.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rerun mobile browser checks after the touch styling change; previous attempt failed because `#btn-fire` had a null bounding box while touch UI was `display:none`.
2. Verify mobile firing, reload, and movement; continue wave/completion or loss/restart checks.
3. Run `npm run build` and `git status --short`, then summarize controls and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, combat, controls, and mission state.
- `src/style.css`: Game presentation and updated touch/mobile UI rules.
- `src/textures.js`: Procedural textures and PS1-style rendering helpers.
- `index.html`: Game screens, controls, and labels.
- `package.json`: Development and build scripts.

## Important Context
- The browser development server was started with `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0`.
- Latest mobile test used viewport 844×390 and showed `#touch-ui` computed as `display:none`; this prompted the unverified CSS fix.
- A follow-up test script initially failed because it read `cfg.browser.launch` instead of `cfg.browser.launchOptions`; browser config is in `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`.
- Current change in `src/style.css` is uncommitted; earlier repository status was clean.
